company_profile.summary: NMDC Ltd (NMDC) is an integrated mining and metals enterprise producing essential raw materials and finished steel products. Operating captive mineral resources, blast furnaces, and modern rolling mills, the company supplies high-grade hot-rolled coils, structural steel, pipes, and specialty alloys critical for infrastructure, automotive manufacturing, and engineering fabrication.

revenue_breakup.desc: Automotive body panels, white goods steel, pipes, and general engineering fabrication sheets.
High-yield strength TMT bars and wire rods for bridges, dams, and urban civil construction.
Granulated blast furnace slag for cement makers, coal tar, and metallurgical coke.

company_profile.geographic_mix: Domestic (India): 82% • International Exports (Europe, Middle East, Southeast Asia): 18%
moats_and_strengths: Extensive mineral integration with captive iron ore and coking coal mines minimizing input cost volatility.
Low conversion costs placing operations in the lower quartile of the global steel cost curve.
Strategic multi-modal logistics with dedicated railway sidings and deepwater port connectivity.
Preferred supplier status with major automotive OEMs for specialized light-weighting high-tensile steel.
company_profile.order_book_or_capacity: Crude Steel Capacity: 15+ MTPA • Captive iron ore security meeting over 70% of internal requirements

bullish_triggers: Strong domestic steel consumption growth driven by Indian railway, metro, and bridge infrastructure projects.
Capacity expansions coming on-stream to replace imported specialty alloy steel.
bearish_risks: Cheap steel dumping from surplus Chinese mills depressing international steel benchmark spreads.
Elevated global seaborne coking coal prices compressing blast furnace operating margins.

liquidation_safety.pledge_deadline: 9:00 PM on T-day (Mandatory CDSL/NSDL OTP authorization)
